name: repository-history-migration
description: Plans and executes sealed, source-read-only Git history extraction into a new repository.

interface.shortDescription: Extract selected paths while preserving Git history.
interface.longDescription: Cross Repo History Migration preflights and seals a source revision and migration plan, then creates a new filtered repository atomically without modifying the source repository.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $repository-history-migration to plan and safely extract selected paths into a new Git repository.
